actions.name: Verify ML Artifacts
actions.description: Verify the cryptographic checksum of all machine learning artifacts to verify that the file or repositiory was not modified by an attacker.

actions.name: Verify the authenticity of feedback data
actions.description: Use techniques such as digital signatures and checksums to verify that the feedback data received by the system is genuine, and reject any data that does not match the expected format.

actions.name: Validate ML Model
actions.description: Validate that machine learning models perform as intended by testing for backdoor triggers or adversarial bias. Monitor model for concept drift and training data drift, which may indicate data tampering and poisoning.

subgoals.control_name: Deployment of AI systems shall be controlled.

actions.name: Employ network segmentation to limit the impact of injected traffic on critical AI systems and isolate affected components.
Model Distribution Methods
actions.description: Deploying ML models to edge devices can increase the attack surface of the system. Consider serving models in the cloud to reduce the level of access the adversary has to the model. Also consider computing features in the cloud to prevent gray-box attacks, where an adversary has access to the model preprocessing methods.

actions.name: Implement Security Control during hardware manufacturing
actions.description: Implement strict security controls and auditing processes during the manufacturing phase, including secure supply chain practices and hardware verification methods, to prevent unauthorized modifications to hardware components or firmware.
